title: 2025北京马拉松成绩、规模与赛道优化（北京市体育局；中国新闻社）
publisher: 北京市体育局（北京日报）；男子/女子名次经中国新闻社稿核对
claims: The 2025 Beijing Marathon, the 43rd edition, started at 07:30 on Sunday 2 November 2025 from the east road of Tiananmen Square and finished on the Olympic Green central Landscape Avenue; the field was 32,000 runners.

Men's winner Lemi Berhanu Hayle (Ethiopia) defended his title in 2:08:10; Debel (Ethiopia) was second in 2:09:27 and Han Il Ryong (DPR Korea) third in 2:09:47; Li Dalin was the leading Chinese runner in 2:11:26.
Women's winner Almaz Genaneh (Ethiopia) ran 2:26:08; Kibor (Kenya) was second seven seconds behind and Dadiso (Ethiopia) third in 2:27:21; Huang Xuemei was the leading Chinese woman in 2:31:28.

The 2025 route kept the classic line but reduced the second-half turnaround points from three to one, extended the North 4th Ring auxiliary-road section to ease congestion, and added scenery past the National Speed Skating Oval (Ice Ribbon) and Aolin East Road.

Medical cover included 610 medical observers, 74 AED rescuers, 100 doctor-runners, 26 medical stations, eight following ambulances and a 200 m² finish medical center; 6,870 volunteers served the race.
Course services comprised eight drink stations, seven drinking-water/sponge stations and seven food stations.
